title: SIFT feature matches files format
body: Hi Thanks for sharing the codes I have a question regarding feature matches cam txt file There are 200 2 100 lines of matching coordinates for two image pairs And I assume the first 100 is target image time t with source image time t 1 and the last 100 is target image with source image time t 1 Do I interpret this correctly And for each line it should be two points x1 y1 x2 y2 Is p1 x1 y1 always from target image and p2 from source image t 1 or t 1

comments.body: Hi yzhang93 thanks for your interests You are absolutely right the first 100 lines are matches between t and t 1 the last 100 are that between t and t 1 And yes x1 y1 is always from the target image Feel free to post more questions if you have

Hi hlzz Thanks for your quick reply I was trying to replicate your experiments and results using your pre computed match files I got the same evaluation results using your pre trained model But when I trained a model from scratch using the provided training command and the default parameters the pose estimation results were much worse than in your paper For snippet results I ve got 0 0106 seq 09 and 0 0092 seq 10 which are close But for full trajectory ATE evaluated using evo I ve got 60 77 seq 09 and 40 28 seq 10 Is there any special tunes or different parameters used to have the best model Did you use any pre trained weights from Resnet 50 Training command I was using match num 100 python train py dataset dir kitti odom match3 checkpoint dir checkpoint dir img width 416 img height 128 batch size 4 seq length 3 max steps 300000 save freq 2000 learning rate 0 001 num scales 1 match num match num

yzhang93 Great Did you use the provided generate full pose py script for the full sequence evaluation In my experience the ATE results for full trajectory is indeed unstable given different models But 60 77 and 40 28 for seq9 10 still seem a bit too large for me I suggest you try different models around the best one you have and see how much they fluctuate Also the full sequence performance is just a weak indicator for how good the relative pose is because we didn t take serious consideration for the scale alignment We only consider the motion average between adjacent frames in generate full pose py not the full pose
hizz Thanks for your advice I did see much fluctuation in different models Now I get results much closer to your results Thanks again for your help
yzhang93 Sounds great Did you start from scratch or using some pre trained models
